subject: Human Body
title: The Thyroid: Metabolic Thermostat
description: A 60-second lesson on The Thyroid: Metabolic Thermostat.

hook.text: A butterfly-shaped gland in your neck sets the speed of every cell in your body. That's your thyroid.

buildup.text: The thyroid produces T3 and T4 hormones. They control how fast cells burn energy, generate heat, and use oxygen.

discovery.text: Thyroid hormones affect heart rate, body weight, body temperature, and even how quickly you think.

twist.text: Iodine deficiency causes thyroid swelling called goiter. It was once common inland, far from iodine-rich seafood.

climax.text: The thyroid is a metabolic dial. Turn it up and everything accelerates. Turn it down and the whole body slows.

punchline.text: One gland in your neck controls how fast you burn energy.

quiz.question: What do thyroid hormones control?
options: The rate at which cells burn energy, generate heat, and use oxygen
